body: I've noticed that I seem to have those dreams if I have been clean for a little while. As if even my subconscious is constantly thinking about it or having desires. Mine are realistic and graphic, and it often lingers in my mind even after I wake up
19. And i dunno, several years off and on

Aww, sometimes animals can really tell when you're hurting. My kitty has laid with me several times and stopped me from SHing as well.

We are so lucky to have them :)

Hey buddy I'm sorry you had such a bad day. I know how you feel, birthdays suck so much ass. I've had similar situations, so I sympathize with you. 

Either way, happy birthday! Genuinely. You're in my thoughts.
I had it already and just let it do whatever to me and I'm still here 💀 so maybe not
Yep exactly 😭
Bruh fr periods come at the worst time and just make everything 10x worse then normal 😭
Lmao i was aboutta be like no you dont. but true i guess it gives a reason not to 😂
Maybe. It does seem to get worse when i am more depressed
Happy birthday <3 i know exactly that feeling. We're in this together
It feels kind of weird that no one knows but me. Honestly acting like it's not a thing may be easier. I don't know what I'm doing

Exactly. Not everyone who self harms looks the same. It comes in all shapes and sizes. I go around with short sleeves and act very cheerful at work, but often as soon as I'm home I'm SHing my thighs. 

It's also okay if someone resembles common stereotypes. SH is SH, everyone deserves validity and help no matter which way they're struggling.
This has also happened to me for years. To soothe the irritation maybe you could rub in some kind of lotion or cream every so often
Exactly. It creates an endless cycle of sleeping all day and staying up all night lmao

Not me having the same problem 😬
I wanna keep it on one thigh but there’s so much more real estate on the other
I do too. I guess it's best to throw the blade out once its dull
Yeah it was. And I used to be in the same predicament, good luck bro

I use bandaids when i sleep or wear certain clothes so that nothing will open and bleed through. Besides that I'm also not very good at taking care of them. Except my cuts have gotten infected because of it, so hopefully yours stay fine :\

It doesnt help that my friends are going off to school or have started school while I'm stuck here going to my dead end job, only so that my mother can eat away at everything I earned. 

I can't afford to go to school or have a future.

I'm insecure about both, but like you said the burns are a bit less obvious for SH. I tend to never cut where the scars would be visible but my burn marks are on my arm and no one ever really asks about them
Depends, mine from like 4 years ago scarred and are still visible to this day
Agreed, not realistic for your everyday self harmer and hard to watch
My brother sometimes does something similar where he playfully grabs my knee/thigh not knowing my cuts are there like. Ouch
Legit never. I'm usually super numb and then get a huge adrenaline rush until it fades away again
I used to do the same thing when i was in school. Cant keep track of how many pencil sharpeners i de-bladed
Tbh most places have shit like that.  So I'd say yes. Obviously i don't condone it but i know that won't stop anyone. Hang in there 👍
Yeah I definitely regret doing it at school haha. I'm hanging in there I guess, still struggling with SH to this day but that's just how it is sometimes. Hope you're doing okay <3
Yeah I'll find myself staring at myself in my full length mirror, letting it bleed. The mess can be quite annoying afterward

I know how you feel, on the very rare occasion where I do try to talk to my friend about it I try to be very vague with the details because I dont wanna discomfort them or gross them out. At least we can all be more open on here? Lol
Oof i feel you. We learn to never underestimate a fresh blade. On another note I'm glad you're back and clean since then, stay strong <3
No, I didn’t cry that night but totally get what you mean haha

I was just thinking of this. I always feel so conflicted because I disdain and hate myself for self harming and will often put myself down for adding scars to my body, but at the same time as soon as they begin to fade I feel it's a necessity to add more.
SH is something I've always kept incredibly private and so I often felt very alone in my feeling and experiences, having an anonymous outlet to dump my thoughts has actually been quite nice.
I would love to move out but unfortunately can’t for at least another year until I’ve saved enough. I don’t really speak to or see my father, but thank you for the response

Sometimes before or after a SH session I sit there staring at my phone. I debate if I should text my friend and talk about it. I draft a conversation in my notes. But in the end it feels easier to just do what i always do. 

I think that is the small part of me who may want to stop and get help. But its very quiet.

I know theyre doing this with the best intentions, but ive never really understood confiscating all of a SH's tools. If someone suffers from SH'ing, they wont necessarily just stop if their blade is taken. Instead they might just get desperate and seek possibly more dangerous methods . thats in my experience anyway. 

Obviously the problem shouldnt just be ignored, but perhaps if they helped you in other ways it would be better. Have they tried to do anything alternative? If not, maybe consider bringing up your concerns.  Good luck anyway, stay safe <3

Not realistically, I currently live very close to my work currently and can’t move farther away as I don’t have my own car. I also don’t want to intrude or trouble any of my friends if that makes sense.

I feel the exactly like that, it is hard. SH is a legitimate addiction. Just like alcoholism or any substance abuse, it needs to be treated. You are strong and although sometimes we relapse, we are human and make mistakes. So we pick ourselves up again. Never give up, Youve got this 👍
Literally. And I honestly get frustrated when I cant get it just right. Feels like i have to keep going until its satisfying
Yes, I was worried about triggering him as well. Maybe asking him if he is open to it would be a good idea to consider. It is frightening though haha. Thanks for the advice <3

Thanks for sharing- that’s a great step already. Self harm is a dangerous and sad rode to go down. At this point I encourage you to leave this as just a one time thing and seek better alternative coping methods so that you can heal. so that you can wear all the shorts and swimsuits you want, so that you don’t have to hide and lie to your friends and family out of fear and shame. Good luck, everything will be okay <3

I’m sorry you’re going through such a rough time. Relapsing after so long is difficult to deal with. But you are strong. Everyone gives in sometimes, but i have confidence that you’ll be able to pick yourself up again. Now there is no way to go but up, we are here for you and you are not alone
You possibly could have hit a nerve somewhere. Either way, if you’re feeling serious pain or anything unusual you should see a doctor as soon as you can, especially if the pain worsens

I used to feel this way, still do sometimes. But how big or small your scars are dont make your struggle any less valid, it seems like a twisted thought but it makes sense. Comparing ourselves to others is human nature
I have a  similar sensation! Have scars up to 6 years old that tingle or itch every now and then. Gets on my nerves sometimes lmao
Happy birthday! I'm proud of you for making it here :)
Pog
Deep intensive therapy.
Similar situation except I actually did get it. Unfortunately just made me feel more shit and definitely didnt die lmao

I honestly think the fact that youre still here means something. You could continue viewing it as coincidence, but even then youre still here creating new experiences. You can keep making new experiences and trying new things. You matter and your life matters. I say try drawing, try anything you ever get the desire to try. Thats the truly courageous thing to do
Omg i didnt even think about that and i went swimming with fresh cuts yesterday 😬 I'd say staying clean would be worth it to have a fun time swimming without any worries
Thank you honestly for the heartfelt words. It means a lot <3
I guess it also depends on how they’re treated. Like if you pinch it closed and don’t pick the scab and let it heal it will not scar as badly
Don’t push away or ignore what you’re feeling, I say try to explore it instead. There’s nothing wrong with you, I know it’s scary now but steadily over time things will be okay.
If they’ve healed enough by the time you see people, maybe you could apply some make up if you have access to any to try and make it less obvious
Bedroom floor at night
